title: SY AirPlay service (iDrive 8)
description: SY AirPlay's service: AirPlay screen mirroring from an iPhone to the iDrive 8 display. Runs h4m4d's AirPlay receiver (airplay-rx, UxPlay's AirPlay library) only while the SY AirPlay app is open, and opens the car Wi-Fi's firewall for it meanwhile. Video only: the sound stays on Bluetooth to the car.
author: smhcnyldz26-prog
